headline: Google добавила в Gemini и Поиск инструменты для учёбы и исследований
topic: Consumer AI product expansion in Search and Gemini for education
summary: Google announced a set of student-oriented AI features across Search and Gemini, including generated interactive visuals and simulations in Search, customized quizzes, file-based study documents, a Gemini learning hub, and background multi-step research reports that can be discussed in Gemini Live.

sources.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools

headline: Amazon сделала Alexa+ бесплатной для совместимых Fire TV в США
topic: Mass consumer distribution of a conversational AI assistant through Fire TV, including AI search, recommendations and smart-home controls.
summary: Amazon said Alexa+ will roll out free to all compatible Fire TV devices in the U.S., including for customers without Prime. The deployment adds conversational content search, AI recommendations and smart-home controls to supported Fire TV hardware and televisions.

sources.title: Amazon makes its AI-powered Alexa+ free on Fire TV, no Prime required

headline: OpenAI представила preview Private Safety Processing для корпоративных клиентов
topic: Enterprise AI safety, privacy and long-horizon misuse monitoring
summary: OpenAI is previewing Private Safety Processing for selected customers: an automated system intended to detect misuse patterns across multiple conversations while retaining none of the customer data. The launch is positioned as an expansion of zero-data-retention safety monitoring for sensitive enterprise use cases.

sources.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections

headline: TerraPower готовит проект энергоснабжения дата-центра с тепловым накопителем
topic: Power infrastructure for AI data centers
summary: TechCrunch, citing Bloomberg reporting, says TerraPower plans to announce its first data-center project in 2026, with groundbreaking expected in 2027. The proposed use of its Natrium design would pair a 345-megawatt reactor with molten-sodium thermal storage, allowing output to better follow volatile AI data-center demand.

sources.title: TerraPower’s nuclear reactor has a secret weapon for powering AI data centers

headline: Warp представила Factories для управления агентной разработкой ПО
topic: Agent-native developer tooling for building, operating, evaluating and monitoring AI software-development workflows.
summary: Warp introduced Warp Factories, a platform intended to let organizations deploy and operate agent-based software-development workflows. It supports model and harness choice, integrates with tools including Jira, Linear, Slack and Teams, and includes evaluation, performance and token-spend monitoring features.

sources.title: Warp’s new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development

headline: NVIDIA выпустила Cosmos 3 Edge для управления роботами на устройстве
topic: Робототехника и physical AI: компактная world model для выполнения манипуляционных задач непосредственно на роботе
summary: NVIDIA сообщила о новом Cosmos 3 Edge — 4B omni-модели с 2B reasoner на базе Nemotron — и опубликовала checkpoint и воспроизводимый рецепт постобучения для роботизированной манипуляционной политики. Модель рассчитана на запуск непосредственно на Jetson Thor, без обращения к дата-центровому GPU.

sources.title: Post-Train NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge for On-Device Robot Control

headline: MWS AI и Rubytech испытали ПАК с китайскими GPU для российских LLM
organization: MWS AI; Rubytech; МТС Web Services
topic: Тестирование российскими разработчиками ИИ-инфраструктуры программно-аппаратного комплекса с восемью GPU китайского производства как альтернативы ускорителям Nvidia.
summary: MWS AI и Rubytech совместно испытали ПАК с восемью китайскими GPU для запуска российских больших языковых моделей. Rubytech подтвердила тесты и сообщила о планах полноценного коммерческого запуска таких ПАКов в 2027 году.

sources.title: ПАКи с китайскими GPU могут выйти на российский рынок в 2027 году
